prompt: Build for this brief: An independent publication; readers discover stories and read long articles. Use Burgundy and Rose: page #FFF8FA, text #48232E, accent #9D244E, secondary surface #F7DBE5, text on accent #FFFFFF. Set headings in Young Serif and reading text in Inter; rounded expressive serif heading with neutral text. Composition: Repeated item tiles with shared metadata alignment, category headings, search and filters. Use body 20px, heading 48px, line height 1.6, reading measure at most 48ch, gap 48px, content width at most 1440px and item radius 8px. Keep letter spacing zero. At 390px use a single reading order, preserve required text and provide access to every control. Use real subject imagery when needed, not ornamental blobs. Check rendered text contrast and overflow; never call this recipe proven beautiful.
